resources.string: Choose your profile. A local PIN protects your photos; each account can set its own return grace period.
Use exactly 4 digits (0–9) and enter the same PIN twice.
Enter your 4-digit PIN. For an older profile, first enter the full previous 6–12 digit PIN.
Could not unlock. Check your PIN. After 5 attempts, wait 30 seconds; repeated attempts may require up to 5 minutes.
Remove this profile from this TV? Photos and the account on your Immich server will not be deleted. You will need the API key to add it again.

Forgot your PIN? Remove the local profile and add it again using your API key. The PIN is only a TV lock, not your Immich password. Background photo screensavers are disabled; preview works while unlocked.
Security upgrade: please add your account again with its server address, API key and a new PIN. Your server photos are unchanged.
Previous PIN verified. Choose a new 4-digit PIN and confirm it. Cancel keeps your previous PIN and leaves this profile locked.
Could not save the new PIN. Try again, or cancel and unlock with your current PIN.
Enter your complete current PIN, then select ✓. Older PINs use 6–12 digits.
Step 1 of 2: Previous PIN verified. Choose 4 new digits. Cancel keeps the old PIN and this profile locked.
Step 2 of 2: Enter the same 4 digits again to save and unlock.
The PINs did not match. Choose a new 4-digit PIN and try again.

For this account, skip PIN entry when returning within the selected time after leaving the app. Media and network access stop in the background. Manual lock, account switching, or an app/device restart always requires a PIN. Anyone using this TV can return during the grace period.
Could not save. Unlock this account and try again.
